args.title: Essay critique: University of California, Berkeley Data Science BA (College of Computing, Data Science, and Society) (Fall 2027)
args.body:
# Essay critique: University of California, Berkeley Data Science BA (College of Computing, Data Science, and Society) (Fall 2027)

## AI policy note
AI policy: feedback_ok. This school allows feedback on content and editing. This critique asks questions and scores the draft. It never rewrites your essay; every word you submit must be your own.
School policy: "Students may receive advice on content and editing, including the use of generative artificial intelligence software to assist with readability, but content and final written text must be their own."

## Prompt (uc-piq-required)
Please describe how you have prepared for your intended major, including your readiness to succeed in your upper-division courses once you enroll at the university.

## Word count
450 words / limit 350 (over by 100 words)

## Rubric
- Why transfer: 3/4
  - Which sentence states the single most important reason you need to transfer now?
- Why this school: 1/4
  - What specific University of California, Berkeley courses, faculty or resources would you name, and why those?
- Academic trajectory: 3/4
  - Which course moved your thinking the most, and does the draft show how?
- Evidence: 3/4
  - Your opening, "The first dataset I ever cleaned by hand", is concrete. Which other moment shows the same skill?
- Word count vs limit: 1/4
  - The draft is 450 words against a 350-word limit. Which paragraph could you cut first?
- Mechanics: 3/4
  - Read the draft aloud: which sentence makes you stumble?

## Questions to consider
- What would University of California, Berkeley gain from you that another applicant could not offer?
- Which project result are you proudest of, and how do you know it worked?

## Claims checked against your profile
- The draft draws on Data Science Club. (evidence: Data Science Club [activity:ds-club])
- The draft draws on Food bank demand dashboard. (evidence: Food bank demand dashboard [activity:food-bank-dashboard])
- The draft draws on food-bank-demand-dashboard. (evidence: food-bank-demand-dashboard [github:food-bank-demand-dashboard])

## Evidence you're not using yet
- Independent ML projects [activity:hf-models]: Builder: Publishes small models and Spaces on Hugging Face.. Could this support the "Academic trajectory" part of the prompt? Describe it in your own words.
- multi-app-agent [github:multi-app-agent] (https://github.com/wolfwdavid/multi-app-agent): Transfer application sprint agent across Notion, Calendar, Gmail and Docs with approval gate and evals. Could this support the "Academic trajectory" part of the prompt? Describe it in your own words.
- ds-club-study-notebooks [github:ds-club-study-notebooks] (mock://github/wolfwdavid/ds-club-study-notebooks): Kaggle-style study session notebooks for the community college Data Science Club. Could this support the "Academic trajectory" part of the prompt? Describe it in your own words.
- WolfDavid/multi-app-agent (space) [hf:WolfDavid/multi-app-agent] (https://huggingface.co/spaces/WolfDavid/multi-app-agent): Hugging Face space; tags: static, agents, evals. Could this support the "Academic trajectory" part of the prompt? Describe it in your own words.
- WolfDavid/food-demand-forecast-small (model) [hf:WolfDavid/food-demand-forecast-small] (mock://hf/WolfDavid/food-demand-forecast-small): Hugging Face model; tags: tabular-regression, time-series. Could this support the "Academic trajectory" part of the prompt? Describe it in your own words.

---
This critique asks questions and never rewrites your essay. Source draft: doc-essay-demo.
